purpose_context: Authored governance is only useful if it reaches the agent doing the work. Today, turning on a mission type surfaces none of the directives, tactics, and styleguides its steps depend on, and a handful of activated artifacts have no path to any consumer at all. This mission closes both gaps so governance that is switched on actually shows up where work happens.
purpose_tldr: Activating a mission type now reaches the doctrine it depends on, and the last few unreachable governance artifacts get wired in.
